text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One night, when I visited the school 
building to pick up something I'd 
forgotten— Several shadows suddenly 
appeared and pinned me down...!

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Voice
Refined Voice
text_block_list.text:
"You've been crying at the academy night 
after night, so something really sad must 
have happened, right? Please don't hold 
back, tell me everything and pass on 
peacefully!"
choice_data_list:
Wait, who are you?! What do you mean, 
ghost?!

text_block_list.name: Familiar Voice
text_block_list.text:
Wait, wait, waaaait! That person might be 
someone I know?! Wait, actually... you're 
a Trainer, right?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I knew it was you, Trainer! Sorry for 
startling you!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Sorry! We were chasing a ghost, and we 
just saw a shadow that looked like one, so 
we thought for sure...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Rumor has it that lately, if you visit 
our classroom at night, you can hear a 
ghost sobbing."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Quite a few kids are scared... So 
Kita-chan and I came to ask the ghost to 
please pass on peacefully.
choice_data_list: I see... So, Rickey, why are you here?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Same for me! I wanted to resolve 
everyone's worries and make them happy☆ 
And I wanted to be of help to my cute 
underclassman, too!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Well, the cause isn't necessarily a ghost, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah! If you don't mind, would you like to 
come along too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
With the Trainer who has "natural 
affinity" on our side, we should be able 
to resolve this whole commotion perfectly!
choice_data_list:
Would it be alright if I go grab what I 
forgot first?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Since we're here, let's go get 
it together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And—after safely retrieving the lost item, 
we arrived at Kitasan Black and the 
others' classroom, where a sobbing ghost 
was said to appear.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It seems... we can't hear the ghost crying 
just yet.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I-I hope it's not an evil spirit...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, about that... Who's to say the source 
of the voice is necessarily a ghost?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'm thinking it might be caused by the 
flow of qi in the classroom. From a feng 
shui perspective, that seems much more 
likely than a ghost.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Bad qi accumulates inside the classroom, 
causing fatigue to build up in everyone 
who visits---

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
When fatigue builds up, it can make you 
look at things in a negative light, and 
sometimes you might even start hearing 
things.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So, if we clean the classroom according to 
feng shui to create a clean space where 
good qi can flow, that might solve the 
problem☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Of course, a ghost could be the cause, so 
I think going ghost hunting like Kita-chan 
and Dia-chan said is an option, but—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: No, let's start with cleaning first!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The classroom gets cleaned up so it's two 
birds with one stone, and i-it'd be a huge 
relief for me too if a ghost wasn't behind 
it...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Phew. I cleared away the clutter stacked 
in the corner and moved the potted plant 
to the northeast! Next is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
choice_data_list: Could this voice be... a ghost?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
No! That sound probably isn't a ghost! 
It's just a poorly fitted door or window— 
Ah! That window...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I see... It's come a bit loose. Because 
the window was hidden behind all those 
stacked boxes, I didn't notice the issue 
with it.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's precisely because we all got the 
place ready together that we could see the 
cause!
choice_data_list: Feng shui really came in handy, huh!
Feng shui really came in handy, didn't it!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's precisely because we all got the 
place ready together that we could see the 
cause!
choice_data_list: Feng shui really came in handy, huh!
Feng shui really came in handy, didn't it!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Rickey☆ Lucky☆ Case closed!!
choice_data_list:
I hope everyone learns just how useful 
feng shui is.

I hope everyone learns just how useful 
feng shui is.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's true... But as long as everyone 
ended up happy first, that's good enough 
for me!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Delivering happiness to everyone through 
feng shui is what I want to do, after 
all!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That's a wonderful attitude! I'll be sure 
to tell everyone in my class about today! 
About how amazing feng shui is!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Jinxes that bring sorrow should be broken, 
but... feng shui that invites happiness is 
simply wonderful, I think!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Really!? Kita-chan, Dia-chan, thank you 
both so much!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Copano Rickey rejoice at having her 
feng shui understood brought a warm 
feeling to my heart.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ahem♪ At this rate, I'm gonna make the 
academy happier and happier!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I agree! I want to resolve the problems of 
anyone in need with a grand flourish!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Me too! I'd like to be of help to 
everyone, and today's activities... were 
so much fun."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
All right! Then the Tracen Academy Rescue 
Squad is officially formed!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, the Tracen Academy Helper Squad!! I 
like the sound of that!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Let's blow away the unhappiness and make 
this a happy academy for everyone!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching the three of them frolic around 
warmed my heart.
